issues.legal_issue: A government department on whose behalf land is acquired may seek a court reference concerning the compensation awarded.
material_facts: Land was acquired for a government department.
The department requested a reference seeking reduction of the compensation awarded for the land.
issues.conclusion: The department was entitled to seek a reference concerning the amount of compensation.
issues.legal_principle: Section 18(1) of the Rajasthan Land Acquisition Act, 1953 expressly permits the government department on whose behalf acquisition is made, as well as an interested person who has not accepted the award, to require a reference on specified objections, including the amount of compensation. The court distinguished the broader wording of this provision from Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_reference: The proceeding concerns a reference to a court for determination of compensation in a land acquisition matter.
predicates.acquisition_for_government_department: The land was acquired on behalf of a government department.
predicates.department_disputes_compensation: The department objected to the amount of compensation awarded.

issues.definition: When a land acquisition compensation reference concerns land acquired for a government department and that department disputes the compensation, the department may seek the reference.

issues.legal_issue: The fact that a collector makes a compensation award as an offer on behalf of the government does not prevent a reference at the government's request to reduce the award.
material_facts: The land acquisition officer made an award that was in the nature of an offer on behalf of the government.
The government department for which the land was acquired sought a reference to reduce the compensation.
The collector made the reference to the court.
issues.conclusion: The reference seeking reduction of the compensation was competent despite the award being an offer made on behalf of the government.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 18 of the Rajasthan Land Acquisition Act, 1953, the acquiring authority may seek a reference concerning the amount of compensation. Although the collector acts as the government's agent when making the award, the collector acts as a statutory authority when making a reference, as stated in Mohammed Hasnuddin v. State of Maharashtra. The agent character of the award is consistent with the principle in Ezra v. Secretary of State for India and does not negate the government's right to seek a reference.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_reference and award_made_as_government_offer and government_seeks_reduction and collector_makes_reference

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_reference: The proceeding concerns a court reference about compensation in a land acquisition matter.
predicates.award_made_as_government_offer: The collector made the compensation award as an offer on behalf of the government.
predicates.government_seeks_reduction: The government sought a reference to have the compensation reduced.
predicates.collector_makes_reference: The collector referred the compensation dispute to a court.

issues.definition: If a collector made an offer-type award in a land acquisition matter, the government seeks a reduction, and the collector refers the dispute to court, the reference is competent.

issues.legal_issue: An amount by which a court enhances land compensation carries solatium and interest.
material_facts: The court enhanced the compensation for the acquired land on appeal.
The court clarified that the enhanced compensation carried solatium and interest.
issues.conclusion: The enhanced compensation was to carry solatium at 10 per cent and interest at 4 per cent per annum from the land acquisition officer's award until realization.
issues.legal_principle: The court directed that the enhanced compensation carry the usual solatium and interest. No statutory provision or earlier case was cited for this clarification in the judgment.

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for acquired land.
predicates.court_enhances_compensation: The court increases the compensation awarded for the acquired land.

issues.definition: When a court enhances compensation in an appeal concerning acquired land, the enhanced compensation carries solatium and interest.
